scope: Published bought-unit and screen dimensions, honest reference geometry, independent illustrative top-hung poses and purchased quantities only. Browser integration and complete installed construction motion are separate checks.

composition.scope: Published purchased-unit/screen dimensions and explicitly illustrative planar appearance/opening data. No factory machining, maximum-angle or installed airtighness certification.

limits: Manufacturer rail sections, glass thickness and four-bar hinge trajectory are unavailable; appearance is explicitly planar illustration, not factory machining CAD.
The maximum illustrative opening is not a manufacturer operating limit.
Whole-unit collision envelopes are conservative purchased-assembly proxies. Final installation, envelope and full construction route have separate gates.
